name: bid-pointer
description: Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari extension: click anything on a bid staging or live site, say what is wrong, get a ClickUp task.

scripts.package: node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.sign:firefox: pnpm dlx web-ext@10 sign --source-dir dist-firefox --channel unlisted --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts
scripts.release: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && node scripts/make-icons.mjs && node build.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
